entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane of ten realms joined by the World Tree, home of gods, giants, elves, dwarves and the dead.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: A realm at the center of the calamity of the Doomskar and later attacked by demons of Immersturm.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: A realm where worthy warriors are gifted pegasus mounts raised by valkyries and feast forever.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: A realm where the gods have moved in and spirits answer a horn.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: An icy realm of the dead, whose ruins hold ancient nobles' treasures and home of the Dread Marn.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm of demons that poured into Bretagard.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The realm of the elves, where the great serpent is expected to rejoin them.

entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: A misty realm where raiders are lost and masks float toward the Mirrorlake.

entities.name: Axgard
entities.description: The impregnable underground kingdom of the dwarves.

entities.name: Gnottvold
entities.description: A realm where giant spiders were banished by Kolvori.

entities.name: Mossrun
entities.description: Home of a Trollking.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree joining the realms of Kaldheim, whose essence is distilled into the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A calamity when the realms crashed together, with Bretagard at its center.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: A god who united the spirits of all the clans into a devastating force.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: God of the Tree, who alone knows how to distill the Cosmos Elixir from the World Tree's essence.

entities.name: Sigrid, God-Favored
entities.description: A warrior favored by the gods.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The god-family granted immortality by the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Cosmos Elixir
entities.description: A magical substance that grants the Skoti immortality.

entities.name: Cosmos Serpent
entities.description: The great serpent revered by elves, whose return the Elderfang await and whom Fynn challenges.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: A clan of Bretagard.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A clan of raiders of Bretagard who are blessed with fire by Toralf.

entities.name: Guldir
entities.description: A Beskir farmer.

entities.name: Stigur
entities.description: One of the Omenseekers who boasts of defying giants.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: Navigators who chart paths between realms.

entities.name: Hakka, Whispering Raven
entities.description: Alrund's raven who soars between realms.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A seer who sees the future as a whorl of omens.

entities.name: Niko
entities.description: A character before whom countless worlds unfolded.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: A being whose snarl of rage shook the World Tree.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: A god of the sea who drowned a skald's village with a wave.

entities.name: Valki
entities.description: The god of lies, described by Tibalt as gullible.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A character who is disappointed in Valki.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: An Omenseeker with every charted path etched in her eyes.

entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: A king who forfeited the warmth of life to serve the god of death, leading a legion.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Raiders who raise scorn poles in conquered villages.

entities.name: Binhald
entities.description: A Beskir veteran.

entities.name: Jolkur
entities.description: A navigator.

entities.name: Rathstaf
entities.description: A Kannah fisherman.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A people of fishermen, scouts and storytellers.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who has stalked countless horrific foes.

entities.name: Fjall
entities.description: A Beskir elder.

entities.name: Egon, God of Death
entities.description: The god of death, who ages backward.

entities.name: Tergrid, God of Fright
entities.description: The god of fright whose shadow tried to kill her as a child.

entities.name: Varragoth, Bloodsky Sire
entities.description: A demon who waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard.

entities.name: Kzarakh
entities.description: An Immersturm gamekeeper.

entities.name: Dread Marn
entities.description: The legion of draugr of Karfell.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: A Tuskeri who headbutted a troll and won.

entities.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
entities.description: God of storytelling whose horn never runs dry.

entities.name: Leidurr
entities.description: An expedition leader.

entities.name: Urik
entities.description: A Tuskeri raid leader.

entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: A god of storm and fire who blesses Tuskeri.

entities.name: Magda
entities.description: A brazen outlaw.

entities.name: Jorn, God of Winter
entities.description: The god of winter who collects a sliver of ice from every realm he visits.

entities.name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
entities.description: A hunter who challenges Koma to a rematch.

entities.name: Kolvori
entities.description: A god who banished giant spiders to Gnottvold and loves her family.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The elvish gods imprisoned in Jaspera trees.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: An elf who seeks to reclaim the divinity of the Einir.

entities.name: Yegar
entities.description: A Beskir warrior.

entities.name: Ogni
entities.description: A Kannah scout.

entities.name: Firja, Judge of Valor
entities.description: Both shepherd and reaper whose judgment is final.

entities.name: Koll, the Forgemaster
entities.description: A smith who forged a weapon from tyrite to awe Halvar.

entities.name: Maja, Bretagard Protector
entities.description: A protector urging the clans to fight as one.

entities.name: Vega, the Watcher
entities.description: A being who sees past, present and future.

entities.name: Iskene
entities.description: A Kannah storyteller.

entities.name: Solrun
entities.description: A Beskir warrior.

entities.name: Haugar
entities.description: A Kannah wayfinder.

entities.name: Ekken
entities.description: An Omenseeker navigator.

entities.name: Rognar the Reckless
entities.description: A warrior who perished after a hundred-day battle with the Ironmaw Dragon.

entities.name: Bjora Dawn-Greeter
entities.description: A figure who pulled down a cliff bare-handed.

entities.name: Vitima
entities.description: A young woman who dared the gods to punish her hubris.

entities.name: Jari Eagle-Caller
entities.description: A figure who fell from cliffs and was snatched by a giant bird.

entities.name: Knorjolvin
entities.description: A Tuskeri raider.

entities.name: Light of Starnheim
entities.description: A radiance that shines where valkyries fly.

events.summary: The realms crashed together in the Doomskar, with Bretagard at the center.
events.quote: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.

events.summary: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single force.
events.quote: Halvar united the spirits of all the clans into a single, devastating force.

events.summary: Sarulf's snarl of rage shook the World Tree.
events.quote: Sarulf's snarl of rage shook the World Tree.

events.summary: Cosima drowned a skald's village with a single wave after he boasted he could outsing the sea.
events.quote: Cosima heard him, and drowned his village with a single wave.

events.summary: Demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.
events.quote: Panic spread like wildfire as the demons of Immersturm poured into Bretagard, slaughtering as they came.

events.summary: Tibalt scolds Valki for being gullible.
events.quote: "Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"

events.summary: The path to Starnheim opened and vengeance rained down on Bretagard's enemies.
events.quote: When the path to Starnheim was opened, vengeance rained down upon the enemies of Bretagard.

events.summary: The elves of Skemfar were stripped of their divinity.
events.quote: Stripped of their divinity, the elves of Skemfar channeled their rage and sorrow into bloody brutality.

events.summary: Kolvori banished giant spiders to Gnottvold.
events.quote: Fed up with webs impeding travelers in other realms, Kolvori banished the giant spiders to Gnottvold, where their webs snare only the occasional rampaging troll.

events.summary: Fynn hid in the snow and shot the great eagle.
events.quote: Fynn climbed the highest peak and waited, still and silent, until the falling snow had hidden him entirely.

events.summary: Koll forged a weapon from tyrite of a fallen Cosmos monster to awe Halvar.
events.quote: Using tyrite from a fallen Cosmos monster, Koll forged a weapon to awe Halvar himself.

events.summary: Narfi forfeited the warmth of life to serve the god of death.
events.quote: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

relations.quote: Alrund's raven soars between realms; no secret is beyond his grasp.
Esika alone knows how to distill the essence of the World Tree into the Cosmos Elixir, a magical substance which grants the Skoti god-family immortality.

relations.quote: To serve the god of death, Narfi forfeited the warmth of life.

relations.note: waded through fire to bring death to Bretagard
relations.quote: "I waded through a river of fire to bring death to Bretagard."

relations.note: Fynn calls Koma to reclaim what it lost
relations.quote: "Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost! Or does the great serpent fear a rematch?"
